description: Defines the ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering review search parameters in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin.

classes.name: ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams, encapsulating filtering options for actionable review searches, including employee identifiers and status filters.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for filtering.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the include employees filter value.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the include employees filter value.

methods.name: getActionableStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of actionable statuses.

methods.name: setActionableStatuses
methods.description: Sets the list of actionable statuses.

methods.name: getSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of self-review statuses.

methods.name: setSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Sets the list of self-review statuses.
